More about Promofy

SBC Summit 2026 takes place from 29 September to 1 October 2026 at Feira Internacional de Lisboa (FIL) in Lisbon, Portugal.

Promofy will be in the Startup Hub at stand S18. Stop by to experience the Promofy engagement ecosystem live — scan, join, predict and see your result on the big screen.

A full walkthrough of the engagement ecosystem: acquisition experiences with Spark, gamification and loyalty journeys, sports engagement, jackpots, Promofy AI and integrations with your existing CRM and operator platforms.

Yes. Book an online demo before Lisbon and we'll review your engagement challenge and the relevant product and integration setup — so your SBC conversation starts a step ahead.

Yes. Promofy operates as a flexible engagement layer over the infrastructure you already use — API-based integrations with leading CRMs such as Fast Track and Optimove, plus custom or proprietary systems. Rewards can be triggered automatically through your existing bonus engine.

Promofy is designed for low-touch, enterprise-ready integration. Most partners complete integration and go live within 2–3 weeks, depending on scope — and campaigns can be created and launched in under 15 minutes with the no-code builder.

Yes. Promofy is built for multi-tenant, multi-brand management across regions and markets, with 30+ languages and multi-currency support out of the box.
